title: Choose the Coinflow dashboard visual world
question: Choose the world that will guide the redesign across Overview, Purchases, Customers, drawers, and responsive navigation.

options.label: The Settlement Atlas
options.lineage: a precise cartographer’s field atlas for live financial terrain
options.thesis: A calm operational map where payment flow, record state, and investigation paths become legible coordinates.
options.viewport: Overview opens as a settlement pulse: a single primary trend, three compact totals, and an active range shown as a lavender route through the period.
options.risk: The map vocabulary must stay functional; ornamental cartography would slow a high-frequency operations task.

raised.raise: Use a disciplined eleven-step tonal ladder so dense records remain readable before color carries any meaning.
Make selected records feel materially retrieved through a measured drawer transition, not a generic modal.
Keep a persistent, visible selection trail from table row to drawer so operators never lose their place.

options.label: The Operator’s Field Guide
options.lineage: a modern technical field manual for a specialist at work
options.thesis: Every screen reads like a high-confidence field guide: decisive headings, clean evidence blocks, and one unmistakable active state.
options.viewport: Overview presents a concise command header, a primary settlement figure, and a single investigation-ready trend with the date range treated as a live instrument.
options.risk: It is the most familiar choice; it must earn distinction through exceptional information rhythm rather than ornament.

options.label: The Exposure Ledger
options.lineage: a darkroom printer’s exposure record translated into a payment-risk workspace
options.thesis: Tonal zones and precise marks make payment risk, record density, and selection depth visible without turning every signal into a color.
options.viewport: Overview balances a luminous settlement zone against compact metric readings; each card’s tonal weight reflects its operational urgency.
options.case: It improves the system’s dense-data discipline, but the darkroom metaphor needs careful translation to avoid obscuring familiar operations patterns.
options.risk: Overusing hatching or exposure notation would turn clear financial data into a visual puzzle.

options.label: The Retrieved Record
options.lineage: an archive wall where selected artifacts pull physically forward from an ordered stack
options.thesis: The table is a shelf of records; selecting one pulls its evidence forward into a focused, layered drawer.
options.viewport: Overview keeps cards in a strict reference grid while one selected trend or record carries the lavender emphasis forward.
options.case: Its retrieval behavior makes drill-down intuitive, though its archive metaphor is less native to finance than the assigned atlas.
options.risk: Too much physicality could make rapid row scanning feel slow.

options.label: Alphabet Storm
options.thesis: A data field where labels behave like weather.
options.viewport: A responsive, animated metric field leads the dashboard.
options.case: It loses on audience identification and product clarity for financial operations.
options.kept: Use one concise, reversible change signal when a filter or date range updates.
options.risk: Its language-first spectacle would compete with the data.

options.label: Cutting Bench
options.lineage: a film editor’s perforated selection rail
options.thesis: Records advance along a tactile edit strip.
options.viewport: The dashboard becomes an edited strip of transaction frames.
options.case: It loses on product clarity and conflicts with the requested calm, light-purple direction.
options.kept: Selected rows retain a clear positional trail into the detail drawer.
options.risk: Its heavy material and orange dominance would overpower the admin task.

options.label: Information Noise Sleeve
options.lineage: a Designers Republic-style dense information sleeve
options.thesis: The interface uses branded signal noise as its data language.
options.viewport: A high-density command surface opens with competing marks and codes.
options.case: It loses on both audience identification and clarity for an operations dashboard.
options.kept: Give the primary active state one unmistakable visual signal.
options.risk: It breaks the simplicity requirement and makes routine scanning exhausting.

options.label: Live Caption Field
options.thesis: Data events land as expressive, animated captions.
options.viewport: The dashboard narrates settlement changes in a kinetic overlay.
options.case: It loses on both axes: the emphasis system is too expressive for the sustained task.
options.kept: Make state changes readable at a glance, with reduced-motion fallbacks.
options.risk: Its motion vocabulary would distract from tabular investigation.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A polished conventional fintech dashboard with familiar cards, side navigation, filters, and tables.
canonCard.viewport: A conventional analytics header leads into KPI cards and chart panels.
canonCard.risk: It is easy to trust but indistinguishable from other admin dashboards.
